english.title: Remain in a part of a restricted zone of a harbour area after a request to leave by the harbour authority
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without lawful authority or reasonable excuse, remained in part of a restricted zone of a harbour area at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) after being requested to leave by the competent authority or a person acting on behalf of that authority
english.legislation: Contrary to section 39(1)(b) and (3) of the Aviation and Maritime Security Act 1990.

english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, without lawful authority or reasonable excuse, remained in part of a restricted zone of a harbour area at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) after being requested to leave by the competent authority or a person acting on behalf of that authority.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale.

Time Limit for Prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
